theory: Qualify the longitude rule and latitude statement as applying to the idealised local solar-time model. Explain that differences exceeding $180^{\circ}$ use signed longitudes relative to Greenwich for dated times, rather than the shortest angular separation; extend the procedure to add or subtract the time difference and adjust the day when a local time is requested.
